annotations.title: F&O daily stats and IV history

description: Daily figures per expiry for one underlying, computed by TejHQ: put-call ratio by open interest and by volume, max pain, futures settle change and buildup (long_buildup, short_buildup, short_covering, long_unwinding), basis, rollover_pct, atm_iv (implied volatility at the strike nearest the forward, 0.14 means 14%) and iv_skew (25-delta put IV minus 25-delta call IV). is_nearest marks the nearest expiry each day. A long from and to gives an IV or PCR history back to 2010. Required: symbol. Without from and to it returns the last 90 days. Up to 250 rows per call, by date then expiry. End of day NSE equity derivatives from 2010-01-04, no BSE, no intraday. Tier: needs a Retail or Pro key (https://tejhq.dev/upgrade).

from.description: First date, inclusive. Default: 90 days before to. Format YYYY-MM-DD.

offset.description: Rows to skip, for paging. Use meta.next_offset from a truncated result.

symbol.description: Underlying symbol, for example NIFTY, BANKNIFTY, RELIANCE. Case does not matter.

to.description: Last date, inclusive. Default: today. Format YYYY-MM-DD.
